reader.requirement: At 85, a relative file's READ/WRITE/REWRITE/START/DELETE executes only after a successful OPEN and only in the open modes Table 2 marks for its access mode (sequential: READ/START in input and I-O, WRITE in output and extend, REWRITE/DELETE in I-O; random: READ in input/I-O, WRITE in output/I-O, REWRITE/DELETE in I-O, no START; dynamic: as random plus START in input/I-O), every blank cell being refused (47/48/49, or a compile-time refusal where a syntax rule makes the cell unwritable: START on random access, EXTEND on random or dynamic access).

edition-consulted.switches: InForce (Year < 2002): at 85 a READ/WRITE/REWRITE/DELETE/START without AT END/INVALID KEY and no applicable USE is refused (COBOL6826); compile-time only, the runtime statement is the same code
DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility (2002+): at 85 every OPEN takes the AllOther file lock and Table 19 is not consulted; no effect on open-mode or position rules

reader.edition-search: grep Edition/IsActive/CobolVersion/Year over the guards and RelativeConnector: the Table 2 cells are decided by access mode and open mode only; BindStart's access-mode refusal and CheckOpenModeForFile's EXTEND refusal consult no edition for these arms.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f20_04 exercises most cells; not exercised: sequential-access WRITE in I-O, REWRITE/DELETE/START in output and extend, random REWRITE/DELETE in output, dynamic REWRITE/DELETE/READ NEXT in output, the compile-time cells (random START, random/dynamic EXTEND)

probes.printed: sequential: OUTPUT WRITE 00 (key 0001), REWRITE 49, DELETE 49, START 47; EXTEND WRITE 00 (0002), REWRITE 49, DELETE 49, START 47; I-O READ 00, WRITE 48 and the file still holds AAA1 AAA2 then 10; random OUTPUT WRITE 00, REWRITE 49, DELETE 49; I-O WRITE/REWRITE/DELETE/READ 00, READ of deleted 23; INPUT REWRITE 49, DELETE 49; dynamic OUTPUT WRITE 00, REWRITE 49, DELETE 49, READ NEXT 47; I-O REWRITE/WRITE/READ NEXT/DELETE 00 (MATCH)
probes.expected: Table 2 X cells succeed, blank cells refused with 1985 VIII.1.3.4 47/48/49

probes.printed: COBOL0862 START on 'F': the access mode shall be sequential or dynamic
probes.expected: random START cell blank in every mode: refused

probes.printed: COBOL2372 OPEN EXTEND 'F' ... RANDOM; EXTEND requires sequential access (c3extenddynamic.cob: same for DYNAMIC)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR4  the text is in the rule (or the clause): "An OPEN statement must be successfully executed prior to the execution of any of the permissible input-output statements"
OK  §1985:VIII.4.4.3 SR1  the text is in the rule (or the clause): "The EXTEND phrase must only be used for files in the sequential access mode"
OK  §1985:VIII.1.3.4  the text is in the rule (or the clause): "The execution of a READ or START statement is attempted on a file not open in the input or I-O mode"

reader.notes: One blank cell has no 1985 status: a sequential-access WRITE in I-O mode (1985's 48 reads 'not open in the I-O, output, or extend mode'); the runtime refuses it with 48 and leaves the file unchanged, a defensible logic-error answer to a statement the table forbids (2023 gives 48 for it explicitly). The compile-time refusals cite 2023 clause numbers in their message text at --std 85, cosmetic only.

refuter.evidence: r1cells-001 at --std 85 probed every blank Table 2 cell the reader left out: sequential WRITE in INPUT 48, READ in OUTPUT 47 and in EXTEND 47 (AT END did not run), EXTEND WRITE 00 with key 0002 (after highest, GR11); random READ in OUTPUT 47, WRITE in INPUT 48 and the record is not added (READ of 2 then 23); dynamic START in OUTPUT 47, random READ in OUTPUT 47, WRITE in INPUT 48, START and READ NEXT in INPUT 00. Compile-time cells re-read: START on random access is refused by 1985 VIII.4.7.3 SR1 (a syntax rule of this edition, so the compile-time refusal is legitimate), EXTEND on random/dynamic by VIII.4.4.3 SR1. The one cell with no 1985 status (sequential-access WRITE in I-O: VIII.4.9.4 GR1 lists I-O as permissible, Table 2 does not, and 48's text does not cover it) is a program that violates Table 2; the rule fixes no status, so 48 with the file unchanged is within latitude. cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR4 'may be used with the open mode given at the top of the column'; OK §1985:VIII.4.9.4 GR1 'must be open in the output, I-O'.
